results.title: A Small Desire
results.overview: Through landscapes and nocturnal glimpses of men claiming public space, a Kashmiri woman narrates her lifelong negotiation with fear, curfews, and gendered restriction. The film is a quiet meditation on how the smallest desires expose the vast inequalities that shape women’s freedom.

results.title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
results.overview: Documentary film that tells the story of Isabel Fuentes. In April 2015, alleged burglars left her on the brink of death in her own home, in the village of Pazos, in Verín. From the very beginning, the Guardia Civil sergeant in charge of the case suspected that the account of what had happened did not add up and tried to protect Isabel from further attack.

results.title: Kate in Maize
results.overview: Katherine kneads clay, shapes it, and fires a cup. A curiosity sparked by this physical sensation leads her to reveal her own body. Sensing this, a lustrous linden blossom breaks away from the tree and begins to drift toward the girl. She crushes it with her hand, and an allergic reaction rash appears on her groin. Back home, the girl encounters three cats.

results.title: Wolf's Egg
results.overview: A child growing up in the countryside is caught between the masculinity role imposed on them and the identity they find in fairy tales, while in real life also being forced to become a wolf.

results.title: Au nord des hommes
results.overview: A group of journalists ventures deep into the Québec wilderness to investigate a camp offering a mysterious retreat for men. Behind the seductive rhetoric and apparent camaraderie lies a full-fledged radical cell: they might have walked straight into a very dangerous engine.

results.title: El cante roído de la excava
results.original_title: El cante roído de la excava
results.overview: Animated collage film by Andrea d'Arbel

results.title: Portrait of possible grief
results.overview: The memorial card — a small, rectangular piece of paper. A name, a date, a face. It is given when something has to be let go: an administrative act, wrapped as a memory. But what if there was someone whose job it was to create that final image?  Lilith is a photographer specializing in portraits for memorial cards. She is contacted when people believe the end is near. From nursing home rooms to cramped kitchens, she moves through the uncomfortable space between existence and farewell, where routine and mortality strangely and effortlessly intersect.

results.title: F**k Me in Saint-Gilles
results.overview: During a jam session in Saint-Gilles, the story of Harry and Tina’s explosive, erratic, lustful affair emerges through music. Every tune reveals a crescendo of sensuality, a heartbreak pause - their jazzy romance is the ultimate 'matching each other's freak'.

results.title: Burn It All
results.overview: A young couple, determined to build their future on land confiscated from the Mafia, find themselves fighting an enemy challenging their very notion of resistance and love. A tense, straight horror that will leave you on the edge of your seat.

results.title: Stuck!
results.overview: Dr. Atkins, the hospital’s expert in removing “foreign objects”, finds himself in a bind when he forgets to get a present for his big wedding anniversary. When the perfect gift presents itself inside a patient, will he be willing to risk it all for love?

results.title: Crunch
results.overview: A woman who suffers with misophonia has to endure a loud crisp eater on the train.

results.title: Tua Tua Keladi
results.overview: The quiet lives of elderly residents in a small fishing village are turned upside down when the Health Department announces that exposure to the chemical P172 triggers a dramatic surge in libido. Amid the panic and awkwardness, the villagers must navigate their suddenly chaotic relationships, reawakened by newfound passion.

results.title: Inspecting the ponds
results.overview: Inspecting the Ponds documents the daily labor and living conditions of clam farmers in Qigu, Tainan, under Taiwan's fishery-solar symbiosis policy. Through pond patrols, seeding, harvesting, and post-typhoon recovery, the film follows Mr. Tsai and Ms. Lin's aquaculture lives, portraying how the arrival of solar development has gradually transformed the relationship between people and the land, and how farmers continue to make choices amid uncertainty and survival.

results.title: A Night Tale
results.overview: In the turning of night and day, one girl stays awake; the other seems to have lost her words. They exchange with each other, and their silence—is she her companion, or her reflection? The city will wear away in time, but some frequency still lingers in the damp dark.

results.title: Chocolate for Christmas
results.overview: When a woman returns home to save her family’s beloved chocolate shop, she finds unexpected love and a renewed appreciation for what matters most. This sweet holiday romance celebrates family, community and the lasting power of tradition.

results.title: Meat the Future
results.overview: Tommy Watanabe, a kind-hearted but naïve Japanese yakiniku chef in Taiwan, believes that good food can make the world better. When a cynical teenager tells him to “become president and fix society,” Tommy takes it literally and launches an unlikely grassroots campaign. As his sincerity attracts public attention, a conman exploits Tommy’s trust and steals campaign donations, forcing him to confront the harsh realities behind idealism and politics.

results.title: Panch Pandav
results.overview: Spanning from the Dwapara Yuga to the present Kali Yuga, Yudhishthira searches for his family in Nepal, where he confronts injustice, corruption, and oppression in a modern-day battle between righteousness and evil.

results.title: Non-Migrants
results.overview: In a small Bulgarian town a young man faces a crisis when his girlfriend plans to emigrate abroad. Angered, he breaks into the abandoned local factory and starts working without any specific purpose, ideology, or political agenda. But this unusual form of “protest” attracts media attention and may unexpectedly restore lost faith and friendships.

results.title: Merry Memories
results.overview: When her nephew is assigned a Christmas scrapbook project for his deployed mother, organized accountant Michaela is forced to partner with charming teacher Bryan to help bring the season to life. What begins as a carefully planned holiday checklist quickly turns into a string of heartfelt, unexpected adventures that draw them closer together. But with Bryan preparing to leave town after Christmas, Michaela must decide if she’s finally ready to let love disrupt her perfectly ordered life.

results.title: 4 OUTS: Back to the Ballgame
results.original_title: 4アウト ─もう一度、プレイボール─
results.overview: Masaki Aiba plays the lead role of Yagami. After being released from a corporate baseball team and feeling despondent, Yagami finds a new job at a sports center for people with disabilities. There, he takes on the role of manager for a baseball team consisting of just five players with disabilities… At first, Yagami was skeptical, wondering, "Can people with disabilities really play baseball?" But as he works up a sweat alongside the players and grows into a true manager, his journey is sure to touch the hearts of many.
